title: Craft crash in northern Iran

tellings.quote: And there was one that crashed and went down in northern Iran that we had to try to go in and

plain: A craft, apparently not of human make, crashed in northern Iran, and the United States had to try to go in after it, according to Steven Greer, a campaigner for official UFO disclosure, speaking as a guest of Michels. Greer gives it only in a half-finished sentence, with no date or detail, as one of a series of such crashes he says the US has tried to recover.
